title: Sharing Skills and Agents
description: Explains how capabilities can be prepared and shared with others.

steps.title: Open Skills
steps.description: Select Skills from the side menu to open skills.

steps.title: Select your Skills
steps.description: Select Created by me to view and select the relevant Skill you want to share

steps.title: Share a Skill
steps.description: In the Skill, select Share to share the Skill.

steps.title: Search for people or groups
steps.description: Search for people or groups you wish to share the Skill with. Select the relevant user or group.

steps.title: Assign permission level
steps.description: Assign the appropriate permission level – Viewer, Editor or Owner before saving your changes. Users can access and use the prompt based on the permissions you grant.

steps.title: Save Changes
steps.description: Select Save Changes to apply your changes and share the Skill with the selected user or group.

steps.title: Access the Skill
steps.description: Once you have shared the Skill, the user will be able to view by selecting Skills and the Skill will be listed under Shared

steps.title: Open Agent Builder
steps.description: Select Agent Builder from the side menu to open Agents.

steps.title: Select your Agent
steps.description: Select the drop-down menu, then search for and select the Agent you want to share.

steps.title: Share an Agent
steps.description: In the Agent, scroll to the bottom of the Agent Builder form and select Share to share the Agent.

steps.title: Search for people or groups
steps.description: Search for people or groups you wish to share the Agent with. Select the relevant user or group.

steps.title: Assign permission level
steps.description: Assign the appropriate permission level – Viewer, Editor or Owner before saving your changes. Users can access and use the Agent based on the permissions you grant.

steps.title: Save Changes
steps.description:
Select Save Changes to apply your changes and share the Agent with the selected user or group.

Note: You will need to also share all the Skills associated with the Agent with the same users or groups
